hero.title: We're
hero.description: A new Canadian startup with a tech team based in Tunis, Tunisia. We're building a truck transportation platform (web & mobile) with dedicated Carrier and Shipper applications. Our initial target market is Canada, with plans to expand to the US next.

keyFeatures.backhaulDescription: AI-powered matching finds return loads, eliminating empty miles and boosting revenue. Our algorithm analyzes historical data, current market rates, and your preferences to suggest the most profitable backhaul opportunities.
keyFeatures.ecoFriendlyDescription: Reduce your carbon footprint with optimized routes that consider fuel efficiency, emissions, and carbon offset tracking. Choose sustainable routes and participate in our green logistics program.
keyFeatures.realTimeDescription: Monitor all your vehicles on an interactive map with live updates. Set geofences, receive arrival alerts, and track multiple loads simultaneously with our advanced mapping technology.
keyFeatures.smartCalendarDescription: Manage your loads with intuitive calendar and list interfaces. Drag-and-drop scheduling, color-coded statuses, and customizable views to match your workflow.
keyFeatures.customizableRoutesDescription: Set your preferences for avoiding tolls, poor road conditions, low bridges, and specific areas. Our algorithm respects your preferences while optimizing for efficiency and cost.
keyFeatures.dynamicETADescription: Get accurate ETAs that update in real-time based on traffic, weather, and driver breaks. Share automated updates with customers to improve communication.

faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.faqHint: Have questions? We're here to help.
faq.subtitle: Get answers to common questions about WeLoad Solutions. Can't find what you're looking for? Contact our support team.

questions.freeTrialAnswer: Yes! All plans include a 30-day free trial with full access to all features. No credit card required to start.
questions.switchPlansAnswer: Absolutely. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect immediately with pro-rated billing.
questions.paymentMethods: What payment methods do you accept?
questions.paymentMethodsAnswer: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and wire transfers for enterprise plans. Annual plans can also be paid via invoice.
questions.setupFeeAnswer: No setup fees for any plans. We believe in transparent pricing with no hidden costs.
questions.nonProfitDiscounts: Do you offer discounts for non-profits?
questions.nonProfitDiscountsAnswer: Yes, we offer special pricing for non-profit organizations and educational institutions. Contact our sales team for details.
questions.cancellationPolicyAnswer: You can cancel anytime. If you cancel, you'll continue to have access until the end of your billing period with no further charges.
